acceptance: Real Markdown, code, and PDF sources ingest, retrieve, cite, and render through generated UI with restart-safe canonical state.

real_source_ingestion.result: Markdown, code, and Docling PDF ingestion persisted three canonical exact-scope sources and survived restart.

retrieval_and_citations.result: FTS5/sqlite-vec hybrid retrieval returned bounded source revision, locator, hash, chunk, and line citations with deterministic lexical fallback.

claim_and_contradiction_governance.result: Cited claims, contradiction candidates, decisions, review state, and reactive projections remained canonical and restart-safe.

rich_artifact_rendering.result: Generated UI rendered provider-neutral bounded artifact descriptors while UIAI retained browser runtime and blob authority.

automatic_targeted_refresh.result: Durable cursor replay refreshed only the exact subscribed Work Surface and suppressed unrelated Attachment updates.
